source.evidenceText: Slide 1 of 7Lyrics, Mild Blood, Mild Suggestive Themes, Use of Alcohol and TobaccoIn-Game PurchasesGamesLet's Sing 2027VersionNintendo Switch 2EditionDigitalLyrics, Mild Blood, Mild Suggestive Themes, Use of Alcohol and TobaccoIn-Game PurchasesLoadingSing your heart out with your friends on your favorite songs in our 1 to 4 players karaoke game.Grab the mic—or your smartphone—and get ready to shine! Let’s Sing 2027 transforms any occasion into a musical celebration with a brand-new playlist of chart-toppers and classics from around the world. Sing solo for high scores or team up with friends and family for unforgettable duets and group performances. Featuring songs with their original music videos, adjustable vocal guide settings, and easy-to-use smartphone and mic support, Let’s Sing 2027 makes singing accessible, fun, and endlessly replayable. Whether you’re hosting a party or chasing your best score, it’s your turn to take center stage!This year, step into Soundtown in an all-new Party mode—a lively musical adventure where you’ll face off against DJ Hush and bring the beat back to the city. With improved visuals, fresh avatars, and customizable rewards, every performance feels like a moment in the spotlight.Featuring 35 chart-topping songs there's something for everyone—from modern hits to timeless classics.* Chappell Roan – The Subway* Lady Gaga, Bruno Mars – Die With A Smile* Alex Warren – Ordinary * Drake – God's Plan * Ariana Grande – we can't be friends (wait for your love)* Sabrina Carpenter – Espresso * Ed Sheeran – Azizam ... source.title: ID@XBOX x IGN Showcase Recap: All the News and Announcements
source.evidenceText: Danielle Partis, XBOX Wire Editor October 20, 2026 · 9 min read We’ve just wrapped up another fantastic ID@XBOX and IGN Showcase, bringing the latest news and updates on many brilliant indie titles heading to XBOX – from world premieres and long-awaited announcements to a fresh wave of titles making their way to Game Pass. We even threw in a surprise launch! The show included the reveal of A Game About Digging a Hole Together, the sequel to the popular subterranean sandbox adventure, and Magenta Down, a new sci-fi adventure. We also announced that several CRITICAL REFLEX titles are heading to XBOX soon, including the frosty cooking sim, Arctic Eggs, which is available today! Many of the ID@XBOX games featured during today’s showcase will also support XBOX Play Anywhere at launch – so you can enjoy them across console and PC at no additional cost. Check out the full recap of everything shown during the event below! A Game About Digging a Hole Together Revealed during today’s ID@XBOX and IGN show, A Game About Digging A Hole Together is a minimalist experience about digging a hole at the beach, now with friends. Dig together, collect resources, sell them, upgrade your equipment and search for a promised treasure buried deep beneath the sand. A Game About Digging A Hole Together is heading to XBOX Series X|S, XBOX on PC, and Game Pass on December 4, 2026. Chronoscript: The Endless End Chronoscript: The Endless End is an innovative, exploration-based action-adventure game comprised of two worlds: a 3D rendered grand residence littered with thousands of manuscript pages, and the 2D pen-and-ink illustrated worlds within them. Face off against the Ruined, twisted remnants of those who lost their lives in the waking world. Grow stronger through exploration and battle, and immerse yourself in the winding narrative of the Immortal Vampire and her Editor. A unique approach to spatial perspective awaits you. Chronoscript: The Endless End arrives summer 2027 for XBOX Series X|S and XBOX on PC. Croak Tongue-grapple and pinball-bounce the frog prince across levels to reach the Witch’s Banquet in this hand-drawn 2D precision platformer. Each whimsical world has its own wacky boss, hidden collectibles, and a unique traversal ability. Hungry for a little competition? Take on your friends and the fastest frogs in the world on the online speedrunning leaderboard. CROAK will be available March 2027 for XBOX Series X|S, XBOX on PC, day one with Game Pass, and supports XBOX Play Anywhere. CRITICAL REFLEX Montage Three unconventional, yet critically acclaimed indie hits from CRITICAL REFLEX are coming to XBOX, with two titles heading to Game Pass and one available today for purchase. Arctic Eggs: Make an omelette out of beer bottles, bullets and cigarettes in this dystopian, physics-and-patience-driven frying sim set in a surreal Antarctic city. Oh, and there are eggs too. Available on XBOX Series X|S today. Mouthwashing: Take responsibility for the dying crew of a shipwrecked space freighter in this psychological horror drama. Coming to XBOX Series X|S, XBOX On PC, XBOX One, and XBOX Game Pass on October 29, 2026. No, I’m Not a Human: Interrogate door-knocking strangers to spot deadly shape-shifting impostors in an apocalyptic anxiety thriller. Coming to XBOX Series X|S, XBOX One, and XBOX Game Pass in 2027. Learn more about what CRITICAL REFLEX is bringing to XBOX in our deep dive here. Drill Keeper Play as a heroic Drill Keeper in this deck-building roguelike siege defense game as you travel the galaxy securing vital resources for your people. As a dutiful symbol of the future, you’ll build fortresses around your mining operations to protect them from the dangers lurking in the depths of distant planets, designing labyrinthine pathways and traps to stall and bewilder the enemy. Build powerful synergies in your deck as it grows over a run, optimize your dig strategy to acquire resources for immediate and future use, and experiment with a multitude of heroes and factions. Drill Keeper launches summer 2027 for XBOX on PC and Game Pass. Graytail Graytail is a mystery action-adventure in a 2.5D pixel-art world. A famous pilot has vanished somewhere in the Pacific. A detective with a headache that never stops takes the case, with the pilot’s daughter at his side. Grab your cane, get on your motorbike, and uncover the island’s secrets. The deeper you dig, the less you can trust. Greytail launches November 2027 for XBOX Series X|S and XBOX on PC, and will support XBOX Play Anywhere. Love is a Roguelite Love is a Roguelite (or LIAR for short) unveiled its world premiere trailer, delivering a unique hybrid where turn-based tactics meet deckbuilders and dating sims, set within a procedurally generated love story. Powered by the proprietary LoveSync system where your choices matter, you’ll manage relationships alongside tactical card combat, utilizing multiple character classes and exploring 16 distinct romantic pairings across diverse gender and species variations. You’ll need to complete multiple successful runs to reveal the complete story when Love is a Roguelite launches in Fall 2027 for XBOX Series X|S and XBOX PC. Magenta Down From the creators of Unto The End, Magenta Down is an atmospheric sci-fi adventure set on a harsh, remote exoplanet. Endure injury and radiation exposure with scarce supplies as you search for a way to save yourself and your crew. Magenta Down is coming to XBOX Series X|S and XBOX on PC in early 2027 – learn more from the developers in our deep dive. Mr. Magpie’s Harmless Card Game Clock in for a sinister roguelike deckbuilder where you’ll build your deck, push your luck, and combine powerful “synergies” to tip the odds in your favour. Every choice is an opportunity to demonstrate your value. With Matt Mercer providing the voice of Mr. Magpie, your deeply unsettling host, you can look forward to a workplace experience where nothing is quite as it seems. It’s just a harmless card game.
